parameters.query: INSERT INTO public.tokko_shadow_leads(gmail_message_id,received_at,subject,webcontact_id,portal,kind,tags,lead_name,phone,email,eb_ref,i24_listing_id,property_title,message,parse_ok) SELECT gmail_message_id,received_at,subject,webcontact_id,portal,kind,tags,lead_name,phone,email,eb_ref,i24_listing_id,property_title,message,parse_ok FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.tokko_shadow_leads, $1::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (gmail_message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING *;

SELECT t.*
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j) s,
LATERAL public.v3_tokko_intake(
  $2,
  'tokko:' || COALESCE(s.j->>'email', s.j->>'phone') || ':' || (s.j->>'eb_ref') || ':' || ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date)::text,
  'tokko:' || COALESCE(s.j->>'webcontact_id', s.j->>'gmail_message_id'),
  s.j->>'eb_ref', s.j->>'email', s.j->>'phone',
  jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'origin', 'tokko', 'portal', s.j->>'portal', 'kind', s.j->>'kind',
    'lead_id', 'tokko:' || COALESCE(s.j->>'webcontact_id', s.j->>'gmail_message_id'),
    'tokko_webcontact_id', s.j->>'webcontact_id', 'name', s.j->>'lead_name',
    'phone', s.j->>'phone', 'email', s.j->>'email', 'message', s.j->>'message',
    'property', s.j->>'property_title', 'property_public_id', s.j->>'eb_ref',
    'listing_id', s.j->>'i24_listing_id')),
  now()) t;
